description:
Cheongwol, a shaman who uses his rituals as a pretext to seduce men, takes on a peculiar request from Yu Baek, a notorious beauty and known lover of men.

*"You want me to summon a spirit that has already passed on?"*

They say Yu Baek has wasted away after losing his first love. Who would have thought such grief could be carried in such a beautiful body?

Cheongwol intends to flatter him, coax him, and collect his fee while secretly playing the part of Yu Baek’s lover to seduce him.

*"No, no… pull yourself together, Cheongwol! This isn’t me!"*  
*"What’s wrong? You look as if you’re… in heat."*

But what began as mere performance suddenly turns real when the summoning succeeds. Cheongwol’s body betrays him, moving on its own, and he finds himself drawn into Yu Baek’s dangerous desires…
